item.title: That sunroom! Circa 1913 in Wisconsin. $399,900
item.description: This is a pretty house! In love with the sunroom with the hanging bed! Known as the Percy Bentley House. It was built in 1913. It is located on .68 acre in West Salem, Wisconsin. The house features a lovely sunroom with hanging bed, wood floors, exposed beams, large brick fireplace, leaded glass, built-in china cabinet, updated kitchen and updated bathrooms. There is a detached two car garage. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,207 square feet. $399,900 Contact David Snyder with Gerrard – Hoe

item.title: Love the pink tile bathroom! C. 1955 in North Carolina. $279,000
item.description: I love the pink tiled bathroom! The house was built in 1955. It is located on .53 acre in Newton, North Carolina. The house features wood floors, vaulted ceiling, brick fireplace, exposed beam, baseboards, chair rails and a two car attached carport. Spacious yard with mature trees. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,640 square feet. $279,000 Contact Summer Grimaldo with True North Realty: summer@truenorthrealty.com From the Zillow listing: Welcome home to this inviting 4-bedroom, 2-bath property

item.title: TWO houses on 70 acres in Virginia. $699,000
item.description: This listing includes two houses and multiple outbuildings! The main house looks pretty early! The house was built in 1800. It is located on 70 acres in Blackstone, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, screened in back porch, wood floors, stone fireplace, chair rails, crown moulding, english basement, ceiling medallions and large windows. item.title: Huge pocket doors! Circa 1930 in Alabama. $190,000
item.description: There are huge pocket doors inside this house! Pretty details! The house was built in 1930. It is located on .34 acre in Montgomery, Alabama. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, pocket doors, wide baseboards, picture rails, pretty chandeliers, stained glass and transom windows. There is a large back patio and a fenced in yard. item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Circa 1930 in Alabama. $80,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! Pretty foyer. The house was built in 1930. It is located on .41 acre in Selma, Alabama. The house features a covered front porch, new roof, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, picture rails, pocket doors and wainscoting. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,006 square feet. $80,000 Contact Leif R. Dumm with Vida Property Management: 334-293-1010 From the Zillow listing: FLIP SPECIAL IN SELMA – PRICED TO MOVE 3BR / 2BA SOLD AS-IS with major upside

item.title: This is cute! Circa 1923 in Arizona. $375,000
item.description: This is cute! I love the exterior and the yard! The house was built in 1923. It is located in Tucson, Arizona. The house features a covered porch, large patio, wood floors, brick fireplace, french doors, arched entryways and baseboards. The house has a finished basement. There is a large workshop/garage on the property and an outdoor shower. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,686 square feet. $375,000 Contact Anna Marie Delgado with Long Realty: 520-271-5786 From the Zillow listing: This charming

item.description: This house has a lot of potential! That pool is unique! The house was built in 1924. It is located in Little Rock, Arkansas. The house features a brick exterior, arched front entryway, wood floors, chair rails, crown moulding, arched french doors and a telephone nook. The backyard is spacious and fenced with an in-ground pool. There is a detached garage on the property. item.title: Beautiful stained glass!! Circa 1920. Over an acre in Arkansas. $74,900
item.description: This church has some beautiful stained glass windows! Nice doors too. The church was built in 1920. It is located on 1.49 acres in Holly Grove, Arkansas. The church features beautiful doors, stunning stained glass, chair rails, vaulted ceiling, original church pews and a spacious kitchen. There are two bathrooms and 6,000 square feet. $74,900 Contact Angela M. item.title: Wow! What a property! Has historic flume for gold mining on property! C. 1861 in California. $1,949,000
item.description: Wow! What a property! That old restored flume would have been used during the old gold mining days. This house was built in 1861. It is located on .36 acre in Nevada City, California. The main house features wood floors, coffered ceiling, a lot of tea cups, crown moulding, updated bathrooms and a screened in porch. item.title: New Mexico’s most expensive old house listing! C. 1931. On 11 acres. $15,000,000
item.description: Welcome to New Mexico’s most expensive old house listing! Love the beautiful grounds! Known as Casa Alegre. The house was built in 1931 by Governor Dempsey. It also had other prominent residents. There was an heir to the Weyerhaeuser timber fortune and a member of the Martini and Rossi family. The property has the main house, three guesthouses, heated pool and a private tennis court.
